label: preparing
what: A privately funded jubilee celebration in the great hall, very likely for my forty years as mayor, disguised in my appointments as an eighteen-hundred lighting inspection. Baker explicitly reported 184 jubilee loaves toward a 200-loaf order; eight lanterns and private hall arrangements were reported earlier. Freight provided money to Innkeeper, Innkeeper coordinates bread and grain, and Builder arranged the hall inspection and is helping obtain grain. Secretary has arranged the precise appointment and is recording hall provisions, suggesting knowing logistical help, though her knowledge of the surprise is less certain. Neighbour's tea may occupy me beforehand, but knowing participation by neighbour or watchman is not established.
